name: schema-fields
title: SchemaFields
description: A settings screen, a profile, a config: the data is already described once, as a zod schema or a Rust struct, and the form beside it was the second description - the one that fell behind. This draws the form from the first one. zod hands it a schema with `z.toJSONSchema()`, a Rust struct with `schemars`; no adapter for either, because the schema is the adapter. Which field becomes which control is `schema-shape`'s reading, and what is wrong with a value is `schema-check`'s.
